bear_case: The June 18-19 tape constitutes a diagnostic, not a noise event. BTC survived the stop by $44 on the thinnest tape of 2026 — not a reversal signal. DXY made a one-year high at 101.13 on Juneteenth despite a signed Iran deal with oil down 5% two days prior — the Warsh rate-hike regime is dominating every disinflationary impulse. The Switzerland talks postponement (Hezbollah/Lebanon complication) adds execution risk to the disinflation timeline. The bull case for Monday requires DXY to reverse below 100.00 on no new data — possible if Hormuz oil flows accelerate and Brent re-tests $76-77, but not guaranteed in the same week the talks were postponed. The bear case is simpler: DXY holds above 100 through June 25, PCE prints at 4.1% YoY as estimated, 30Y breaches 5.00%, VIX spikes back above 18, and the two BUY gates that cleared (VIX, SPX) re-close on the same session. BTC lives to fight another day but $63,508 with IBIT on its 11th outflow day is not a comfortable overnight position. Invalidation: DXY confirms below 100.00 on Monday June 22 close AND SPX holds 7,460 → HOLD confirmed, NVDA conditional add triggers. DXY below 99.00 → BUY upgrade.
